name: add_to_wishlist
description: Add an item the child has explicitly said yes to. Call this only after a clear yes. The worker caps the list at 5, drops duplicates, and rejects unsafe items.

item.description: Short, parent-friendly name of the toy or experience

reason.description: One sentence why the child liked it

name: remove_from_wishlist
description: Remove an item the child has clearly changed their mind about. Worker-side only. This is not a robot command.

reason.description: Short note that the child changed their mind

name: finish_session
description: End the session after a recap, an early stop, a timeout, or a safety concern. Worker-side only. This is not a robot command. Reason safety makes the worker email Mum only.

detail.description: Short plain reason, for example the child said they were done

name: set_mood
description: Show how the robot feels, using lights and head movement. The robot has no screen.

name: nod
description: Make the robot give a small encouraging nod

name: shake
description: Gentle head shake for a no or for thinking
